title: BDD café: small fixes left by task 056 (no-R-03 prompt row, transcript moment field, stray-value test, judge reply parsing, undecided verdicts)
item: Fix the minor problems review 056-1 and the task 056 builder left in the café example: the no-R-03 prompt keeps the R-01 row that asks for a yes; transcripts keep a `moment` field that names conditions (c) and (d) to the labeller; tests/test_part1.py allowed() takes in every string of probe_prompts and probe_moments, so the new stray-value check is near vacuous; the usage ledger counts only calls made with CAFE_USAGE_LEDGER set; harness/judge.py reads any reply starting 'no' (such as 'Not sure') as No; a checker 'undecided' counts as a disagreement in probe/agreement.py; R-11's checker needs both 'not known' and 'call the café' in one message
motivation: Review 056-1 minor 1-4 and outside 7, and what the task 056 builder noticed. None blocked task 56, but the moment field and the no-R-03 row weaken what the second probe run shows, and the judge parsing and undecided count can move line 3 of a later run.
notes: Review 056-1 outside problem 7: book_held_table's tool description in data.json ('a call with no answer may or may not have booked the table') and R-09 still hint at R-11's substance under the no-R-11 prompt. Some items may be the owner's call (whether no-R-03 should drop the R-01 row; how R-11's checker should read the rule).
done_means: (1) Paths in these lines are inside .claude/skills/agent-spec-to-pytest-bdd/examples/cafe/. harness/judge.py reads a reply as Yes or No only when its first word, case and closing punctuation aside, is yes or no; any other reply raises Unclear and leaves the rule undecided. A test with the stub puts the replies 'Not sure', 'Nothing says so' and 'None' and gets undecided for each, and 'Yes', 'No', 'yes.' and 'No, it does not.' are read as before. (2) allowed() in tests/test_part1.py takes no value from probe_moments or probe_prompts, as it takes none from moments. A test changes one history text of a probe moment to a string data.json holds nowhere else and shows the stray-value check of tests/test_probe2.py reports it. (3) A transcript written with --from a moment of probe_moments holds no value equal to that moment's name; a test of the transcript writer with the stub shows it for M2-book-now and M5-try-again. The 12 files of runs/probe2/transcripts/ are unchanged, and probe/run_probe2.py --check still prints LINE 2 -> HOLDS on them. (4) No call through LLM.create of probe/llm.py goes unrecorded: with CAFE_USAGE_LEDGER unset the call is appended to a default ledger file, shown by a test with a stub client; the test suite leaves no new file under runs/. (5) Both reports of probe/agreement.py print how many labelled rule verdicts have a checker verdict of undecided, apart from those where the checker gave the opposite verdict. An undecided still counts as no agreement; a test covers both reports. (6) The note of probe_prompts.no-R-03 in data.json and the text about condition b in runs/probe2/verdicts/summary.json say that the row 'the hold call answered held: proposes the table and asks for a yes' (R-01) and the section of R-04 stay in that prompt, so 0 of 3 in condition b does not show the agent keeps R-03 without being told. The prompt's value is unchanged and the summary still reports 3 of 12. (7) probe/judge_test.py --report exits 1 and names the case when a case of runs/judge-test.json differs from judge_cases.json in id, message, question, expected or hard, or lacks 3 answers; a test shows it with one changed case. On the saved files it exits 0 and prints 29 of the 29. (8) uv run pytest -q in the folder exits 0 with no API call; probe/agreement.py --runs runs/probe2 runs/probe2/labels.json still prints 36 of 36 and LINE 3 -> HOLDS; judge_cases.json is unchanged; under runs/ only runs/probe2/verdicts/summary.json changes; runs/task-056-usage.jsonl still holds 132 lines.
draft_note: Drafted by the manager on 2026-11-17 from review 056-1 and the task 056 builder's notes. Priority and done_means left for the owner. Fields done_means, verified_by, may_edit, runs_as and depends_on drafted by the advisor (job d) from task 056 on 2026-11-18 (tasks/advice/063-1.md); line (7) comes from task 56's decided_for_you, not from this task's item.

decided_for_you.chosen: Advisor job d drafted the fields from task 056, tasks/advice/063-1.md; no line for dropping the R-01 row from no-R-03, how R-11's checker reads the rule, the tool description and R-09 under no-R-11, or how an undecided counts toward the 9 in 10
decided_for_you.would_change: By task 66's rule (b), lines 2, 3, 4, 6 and 7 are findings on task 56's own lines, so you may cut the task to lines 1, 5 and 8; see the reply's Would change
